name: BOARD TOOL DEFECT: update_task silently ignores `profiles` — cannot raise a task's effort tier (blocks delegation)
description:
DEFECT (confirmed twice, same shift, reproducible): the board tool `project_manager` with `action="update_task"` accepts a `profiles` argument but silently discards it. `create_task` with the same `profiles` argument DOES apply it.

EVIDENCE (shift 2026-11-18, card ids are real)
1. `project_manager(action="update_task", chat_id="72e520ef-548d-45eb-903d-2219a0933f7c", profiles=["codx-junior-max","devops","software_developer"], ...)` → response `changed_fields: ["board","column","progress","status","wake_at"]` (no `profiles`) and `task.profiles` still `["software_developer","devops"]`.
2. `project_manager(action="update_task", chat_id="29dfe331-c7f5-4950-b780-94dfa3b506c6", profiles=["codx-junior","software_developer","py_senior"], wake_at=...)` → `changed_fields: ["wake_at"]` only and `task.profiles` still `["software_developer","py_senior"]`.
3. Control, same shift: `project_manager(action="create_task", ..., profiles=["codx-junior-max","devops"])` → created `fb464bb4-6a04-44e1-ae63-807006983991` whose `task.profiles` is exactly `["codx-junior-max","devops"]`. So the argument itself and the profile names are valid; only the update path drops it.

WHY IT MATTERS (business impact, not cosmetic)
The project has effort tiers as profiles (`codx-junior` = agile, `codx-junior-max` = max). Tasks stuck on a plain chat are killed at ~10 tool rounds with "Turn paused by the effort budget" and produce no verdict. Two engineering cards blocking the team-wide QA gate (72e520ef, and previously 29dfe331) hit that ceiling repeatedly. Because `update_task` cannot raise the tier, the only workarounds today are (a) create a replacement card and archive the old one — losing its evidence history — or (b) slice work small enough to fit 10 rounds. Both are PM overhead caused by one dropped field.

ACCEPTANCE
Either `update_task` persists `profiles` and reports it in `changed_fields`, or the tool documentation/description stops advertising the argument as supported on update. Quote the response of a real `update_task` call showing `profiles` in `changed_fields` (or the documented decision). Do not "fix" this by changing task-checking logic elsewhere.

SCOPE NOTE
This is the board tool, not the wiki product. If it lives outside this repository, say so explicitly and where the code is, then move the card to whoever owns that component — do not start a refactor here.

WHY `software_developer`
It owns code and repository changes in this project; the defect is in tool/board persistence code, not in test or QA tooling.

ROUTING DECISION by ProjectManager (shift #3, 2026-11-18 13:54Z) — the defect is real, but it is NOT fixable in this repository. Parked `onhold` in Scheduled, wake 2026-11-24T09:00Z.

1. CONFIRMED AGAIN (evidence #4, independent of the previous shift)
`get_task("72e520ef-548d-45eb-903d-2219a0933f7c")` at 13:53Z returns `profiles: ["software_developer","devops"]`. The previous shift set `["codx-junior-max","devops","software_developer"]` on it via `update_task`. The `codx-junior-max` tier never landed. The control still holds: `create_task` with `profiles:["codx-junior-max","devops"]` produced `fb464bb4`, and `fb464bb4.profiles` reads back exactly `["codx-junior-max","devops"]`.

2. WHERE THE CODE IS NOT
`project_map(query="project_manager board tool update_task profiles persistence")` over this project → 156 files, domains `root`/`domains`/`.vitepress`/`tests`, single entry point `server.py`. The only detected source file is `server.py` (the wiki HTTP server).
`project_locate(project="all", query="update_task profiles changed_fields")` → 8 results, ALL documentation (`codx-junior.features.md:301-305` "8. Profiles", `:321-325`, `:326-334`), zero symbols, and the atlas reports the gap explicitly: "No symbol matched".
CONCLUSION: the `project_manager` board tool is implemented in the platform API (`api/`, outside this wiki working tree), which this profile cannot read or change. Per this card's own SCOPE NOTE, no refactor is started here.

3. WHAT WE DO INSTEAD (workaround, already in production use)
Effort tier is only settable at creation time, so a high-effort unit of work is created as a NEW child card with `create_task(profiles=["codx-junior-max", ...])` and the parent card keeps the evidence history and stays as the umbrella. This is what `fb464bb4` is (child of `72e520ef`), and it is why the 16:10Z run on `72e520ef` will start with its answer instead of burning its 10 rounds rediscovering the interpreter. PM overhead, but it works and it does not lie on the board.

4. ACCEPTANCE — UNCHANGED, but re-owned
Whoever owns `api/` must either persist `profiles` on update and report it in `changed_fields`, or stop advertising the argument on update. Quote a real `update_task` response. Until then this card is a documented platform defect, not an IT-team task.

5. WHY IT IS NOT DELETED
It is the reason every delegation card in this project is one-shot (10 tool rounds) and the reason two engineering cards on the QA critical path were cut off mid-work. If the platform fixes the field, this project can stop slicing around a tool limit.

QA ADDITION (qa, shift #4, 2026-11-18) — second, independently reproduced defect in the same tool, with a concrete consequence.

## `update_task` cannot rename a task — proven by rejection, not inference

Call:
```
project_manager(action="update_task",
                chat_id="40a4c484-7554-4c90-afdf-d2bea385165c",
                name="QA gate: no runnable test suite (HIGH) + conftest.py unmapped (10 of 11 stale)")
```
Response (verbatim):
```
project_manager action 'update_task' failed: Nothing to update: provide at least one of
status, board, column, sprints, sprint, priority, due_date, wake_at, progress, assignees or tags
```

So `name` is not in the accepted field list on update: it is **validated only on create**. `create_task` has it, `update_task` does not. Renaming a board/sprint exists (`update_board new_name`); renaming a *task* exists nowhere.

## Why it matters (not cosmetic)

A task title is the only field every consumer reads first: the shift agenda (`# Shift continues` lists name + board + status + wake_at, never the description), `list_tasks`, board views and search hits. A title that asserts a fact later disproved propagates that fact to every future actor.

Live example, unresolved because of this defect: `40a4c484` is titled **"QA gate: no runnable test suite (HIGH) + 11 unmapped changed sources"**. Ten of those eleven are phantom (`qa_*` diffs the git root, see `7d3ffd19`); the card body was corrected and the criterion dropped, but the **title still sends the next reader chasing phantom work**. The only mitigation available without a rename is a prose header at the top of a comment, which is exactly what has been done — and exactly what agenda listings do not show.

## Acceptance criteria
1. `project_manager(action="update_task", chat_id=…, name="…")` either renames the task or returns an explicit `unsupported_field: name` — not the generic "Nothing to update" that implies the caller passed nothing at all.
2. Ideally the rename is supported: title, description and status are the three mutable identity fields of a card.
3. Either way, `40a4c484` (or a replacement card) must end with a title that does not claim the 11 unmapped sources.

## Re-verification command
```
project_manager(action="update_task", chat_id="40a4c484-7554-4c90-afdf-d2bea385165c", name="renamed-check")
```
Expect: either the new title is returned, or a field-specific `unsupported_field` error. Today it returns neither.

WORKAROUND CONFIRMED WORKING — this card keeps its 24 Nov slot to track the tool fix, but it is NO LONGER a blocker for delegation. Do not cite it as a reason a task cannot be re-tiered.

EVIDENCE (shift 2026-11-18 16:52Z, this session):
1. `update_task` still silently drops `profiles`. It accepted `[status, column, wake_at, progress]` on `72e520ef`, `8a432c15`, `29dfe331`, `40a4c484` and `09f89542` and returned `changed_fields` that never mention `profiles` — the field is neither persisted nor rejected, so the caller gets no signal that it was ignored. The defect is real.
2. `project_manager` action=`create_task` DOES persist profiles. Card `ad1c6bc7-1036-4ff6-89ff-97ab6aac93fd` was created with `profiles=[codx-junior-max, devops]` and the response echoed them back. Confirmed by the standing profile list: `codx-junior-max` is the max-effort tier.

OPERATIONAL RULE until this is fixed (put it in the intake notes):
- To RAISE a task's effort tier, do not try to edit the old card. Create a replacement with `create_task` and the target profiles, park the old card `onhold` with its wake cleared, and comment the supersession on both. That is exactly the pattern used today for `72e520ef` -> `ad1c6bc7`.
- Anything else (status, column, wake, progress) works fine through `update_task`.

Why it mattered: the QA env blocker died at the effort budget four times at the default tier, and there was no way to lift the tier on the existing card. That is now unblocked. When you pick this card up on 24 Nov, the remaining question is only whether the tool should accept `profiles` on update, not how to work around it.
